meta.title: 额头美学设计
meta.topic: 医美 · 面部美学 · 额头

scenes.title_cn: 额头决定上庭与侧脸的衔接
scenes.title_en: The Forehead Bridges the Upper Face and Profile
scenes.context: 额头是上庭的主体，它决定从发际线到眉骨的过渡是否流畅，也影响侧脸从眉骨到鼻根的整体节奏。
sentences: 额头是上庭的主体。
The forehead is the core of the upper third.
upper third（上庭）
它决定发际线到眉骨的过渡。
It decides the transition from the hairline to the brow bone.
transition（过渡）
侧脸的节奏，从眉骨延伸到鼻根。
The profile rhythm runs from the brow bone to the nasal root.
nasal root（鼻根）
paraphrase: The forehead sets the tone for the whole upper face.
A clean bridge from hairline to brow makes the face feel composed.
scenes.speak: The forehead is the core of the upper third. It decides the transition from the hairline to the brow bone. The profile rhythm runs from the brow bone to the nasal root.

scenes.title_cn: 三个设计维度：高度、弧度、平面
scenes.title_en: Three Dimensions: Height, Curve, and Plane
scenes.context: 额头设计看三个维度：高度（上下占比）、弧度（正面的圆润与侧面的平直）、平面（眉骨上方是否有自然的过渡台阶）。
sentences: 高度决定额头上下的比例。
Height sets the up-down proportion of the forehead.
proportion（比例）
弧度太圆显幼态，太平显硬朗。
Too round a curve reads youthful; too flat reads hard.
youthful（幼态）
眉骨上方的过渡，要有一个自然的台阶。
Above the brow bone, there should be a natural step.
natural step（自然台阶）
paraphrase: Height, curve, and plane work together, not alone.
Both extremes — too round and too flat — miss the balance.
scenes.speak: Height sets the up-down proportion of the forehead. Too round a curve reads youthful; too flat reads hard. Above the brow bone, there should be a natural step.

scenes.title_cn: 设计结论：额头是气质的天花板
scenes.title_en: The Takeaway: The Forehead Caps Your Vibe
scenes.context: 额头直接影响幼态感、成熟感与精致感。设计方案时，把它当作上庭与侧脸衔接的枢纽，而不是独立部位。
sentences: 额头是气质的天花板。
The forehead caps your overall vibe.
cap（封顶/决定上限）
它直接决定幼态感、成熟感与精致感。
It directly decides how youthful, mature, or refined you read.
refined（精致的）
额头设计从来不是局部设计。
Forehead design is never a local decision.
local decision（局部决定）
paraphrase: Your forehead sets the ceiling on your look.
Design it as the hinge of the face, not an island.
scenes.speak: The forehead caps your overall vibe. It directly decides how youthful, mature, or refined you read. Forehead design is never a local decision.

practice: The forehead is the core of the upper third.
Too round a curve reads youthful.
「额头决定气质上限」用英文怎么说？
「额头设计不是局部决定」怎么讲？
Forehead design is never a local decision.
pitfalls: Treat it as the bridge between upper face and profile.
A forehead only works in context with hairline, brow, and nose.
Make the forehead as round as possible.
Balance the curve between youthful and hard.
Extreme curves tip the face into a caricature.
Ignore the transition at the brow bone.
Design a natural step above the brow.
A flat seam above the brow ruins the profile flow.
Let the face thirds decide the height.
Height without proportion throws the whole face off.
